newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan PM names first six ministers.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan PM names first six ministers.

text.p: Pakistan's new Prime Minister Nawaz Sharif named his first six cabinet ministers on Tuesday, including some heavyweights from his party and close associates, state television reported.

President Farooq Leghari administered the oath to the new ministers, including Pakistan Muslim League (PML) secretary-general Sartaj Aziz, Sharif's close associates Nisar Ali Khan and Ishaq Dar and Punjab province PML chief Shujaat Hussain. Their portfolios were not immediately announced.
The other ministers were former National Assembly (lower house) speaker Gohar Ayub Khan and former Information Minister Abida Hussain.

A little-known parliamentary deputy from Sindh, Asghar Ali Shah, was named minister of state, equivalent to a deputy minister, and PML information secretary Mushahid Hussain, who is not a parliament member, was appointed adviser to the prime minister with the status of a cabinet minister.
Sharif will name more ministers later on, political sources said.
